text: this is great menu. nice job. hey one thing it is exposing though and this is a framework problem is when that modal is open my clicks are still hitting the things behind all of it and thats a real problem to stab asap
resolution: Added a framework-level blocksPointerEvents node prop so visual-only modal scrims can consume hit testing without no-op JS handlers. Wired it through V8 prop parsing/removal, layout/events hit tests, hover/right-click/scroll blocker paths, engine canvas/terminal fallback gating, hit diagnostics, and the hmsc workspace mock dialog scrim. Added a layout unit test proving an overlay beats an interactive sibling behind it. Verified with zig build test-layout and SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 ./tools/rjit ship hmsc-workspace-mock.
